guard.note: the 1/32-block sweep, one IObjectPicker.clip per step (COLLIDER, Fluid.NONE, the camera entity), hits only shorten |x| and |y| (distance + |offset| x scale - bbWidth / 3, at least 0); no hit = (signum(x) |x|, signum(y) |y|, z)
the predicate the loop hands to clip (the plan asks the same method)
the predicate: ShoulderSurfingCamera.hasNoCollision, then BlockHelper.isPillarPart when ignoring block pillars: reads only
the configured non-collidable expressions tested against a non-full block's id: reads only
four neighbour collision shapes: reads only
vanilla traversal; a block hit needs the context's block shape to be hit (clipWithInteractionOverride) and the predicate false; Fluid.NONE gives an empty fluid shape
declared methods incl. the clip lambdas (tester and miss result)

traverseBlocks: visits only cells of the segment extended by 1e-7 x its length at both ends

shouldersurfing_camera_sweep_prefilter.conversion: @Inject HEAD cancellable on DynamicOffsets.calcDynamicOffsets (Shoulder Surfing 1.21.1-5.3.0; its hit handling now subtracts a third of the entity's width, which only matters on steps that still trace): one pass over the blocks of the swept region's box keeps the blocks that can be hit (non-empty collision shape for the camera entity, not exempted by the method's own predicate); none: the method's no-hit result; @Redirect of the loop's IObjectPicker.clip: a step whose segment box holds no kept block answers a shared miss result; a plan that does not pay (over 16 kept blocks, or under 8 traces skipped) leaves the next 1, 2, 4 ... 32 calls unplanned (helper bons.furious.patch.shouldersurfing_c49.CameraSweep)
shouldersurfing_camera_sweep_prefilter.license: Shoulder Surfing Reloaded (MIT): no Shoulder Surfing code is carried; the pre-scan calls the mod's own predicate and Minecraft's shape methods
